title: PNG communities stuggle with El Niño drought
byline: RNZ; Te Reo Irirangi o Aotearoa
paragraphs: PNG communities stuggle with El Niño drought
Many parts of Papua New Guinea (PNG) are feeling the full force of El Niño, with devastating impacts now reported from the Highlands to the coastal provinces.
The prolonged dry spell is now escalating into a national humanitarian concern, affecting water, food, health and livelihoods.
